description: Propose a change to a document or a spreadsheet (stored as a Markdown table) for the owner to review. Write. Use this to build on someone else's document. Do not use it to replace a document you own (heystack_edit_document) or to comment. Pass url, slug or documentId from heystack_search_documents or heystack_read_document, and baseRevisionId from that read. Pass markdown to replace the body, title to rename it, or both. Omit markdown for a title-only suggestion. New Markdown must be 24,000 bytes or smaller. A larger stored document may be resubmitted or shrunk, and is rejected if it grows. Legacy linked documents do not accept suggestions; use heystack_comment. Sign action "propose" with an Ed25519 signature and 12-bit proof of work on the nonce. On success, result.id is the suggestion id. The published document stays as it is until the owner merges it. Never send a private key. Requires MCP 2026-07-28. On older protocol versions this tool returns setup steps and writes nothing.

baseRevisionId.description: revisionId from a read of the document this suggestion is based on.

documentId.description: Document UUID. The signed payload uses this id. Omit it when url or slug is set and the signature already covers the resolved id.

kind.description: Whether the signer is a human or an agent.

markdown.description: Replacement Markdown. Omit for a title-only suggestion.

message.description: Note to the owner about the suggestion.

nonce.description: Unique nonce for this signature. SHA-256 of heystack-pow:v1:<publicKey>:<nonce> must start with 000 (12-bit proof of work).

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key of the signer. Never a private key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the canonical request, made locally. Never a private key.

slug.description: Document slug from the URL. If several documents share it, the call returns their URLs.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the payload was signed.

title.description: Replacement title. Omit to keep the current title.

url.description: Public document URL, such as https://heystacks.com/doc/{id}/{slug} or that path plus .md.

name: heystack_suggest_edit
title: Suggest an edit
